references.text: Identical offering brought by Nahshon son of Amminadab. Same weight on the silver plate (130 shekels) and the silver bowl (70 shekels), both filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.
Identical offering brought by Nethanel son of Zuar. Same pattern with silver plate, silver bowl, and grain offering.
Identical offering brought by Eliab son of Helon. Shows the repeating pattern of the tribal leaders' gifts.
Identical offering brought by Elizur son of Shedeur from the tribe of Reuben.
Identical offering brought by Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai from the tribe of Simeon.
The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard measure for weighing, the same scale used here.
Regulations concerning a grain offering (minha) of fine flour mixed with oil, which is what fills the vessels in this verse.
Fine flour (solet) mixed with oil used in the sacrificial service, the same ingredients as in the grain offering here.
